evidence.workerWrites: INSERT INTO code_features (feature_id, source_ref, symbol, kind, language, line_start, line_end, packet_key, domain_class, static_tags, summary, created_at, updated_at)
evidence.workerPacketKey: packet_key is written from the live packet join and is intentionally not synthesized in the worker
evidence.structuralFactsWriter: INSERT INTO feature_structural_facts (packet_key, source_ref, feature_key, tree_node_id, symbol_name, symbol_kind, structural_path, line_start, line_end, imports, calls, exports, content_hash, parser_version, processing_pass_id, metadata, created_at)

notes: The original TODO wording mixed the worker path with the structural-facts backfill path.
The live worker path is packet-key joined and writes code_features.
feature_structural_facts is persisted by the atlas_packets backfill path with packet_key preserved as the join key.
